sources.title: MySQL 8.4 Reference Manual: Locking Reads
sources.summary: FOR UPDATE locks matching index records until commit/rollback; locking reads require a transaction. SKIP LOCKED can give an inconsistent view.
sources.client_cross_check: WebApiClient.cs:190-216,255-275 retries requests; durable atomic state required by existing E paired mutations
sources.conflicts: No original game database design inferred. Shared record lock slots are this server's design.
sources.confidence: verified database mechanism, tested on MySQL 8.4.13

sources.title: MySQL 8.4 Reference Manual: How to Minimize and Handle Deadlocks
sources.summary: Use consistent operation order and short transactions; applications must handle deadlock rollback. This implementation reloads on explicit retry and never retries ambiguous connection failures.
sources.client_cross_check: Original wrappers do not supply a general operation nonce; WebApiClient.cs:190-216 network retries cannot authorize duplicate grants
sources.conflicts: Old D integration prose suggested listing before player locks; all new adapters must use players then shared keys

sources.summary: DDL including CREATE/ALTER TABLE and CREATE DATABASE implicitly commits. Run schema/migration before gameplay transactions, never inside a unit of work.
